commands.command: conda run -n TFB_py311 python -m ruff check src tests tools
conda run -n TFB_py311 python -m compileall -q src tools tests
conda run -n TFB_py311 python tools/generate_static_goldens.py && conda run -n TFB_py311 python tools/generate_publication_goldens.py

known_limitations: The Engine uses deterministic polling rather than a background filesystem subscription.
VisualPatch persistence covers expansion and annotations; CanvasDocument begins in Stage 6.
Source-changing transactions and CLI routing through Engine begin in Stage 7.
